issues.title: Coupon not applying on checkout
issues.problem_statement: The customer's coupon code was not applying at checkout and an "Invalid coupon" message appeared; the customer wanted to use it on the Advanced Course.

issues.title: Wrong company name in invoice GST section
issues.problem_statement: The company name in the GST part of the customer's invoice is showing incorrectly.

issues.title: Coupon expiry date extension
issues.problem_statement: The customer wants to extend the coupon's expiry date.

items.description: Support explained that the coupon was assigned only to the Starter Course and not to the Advanced Course, so the product needs to be assigned to the coupon.
evidence: Coupon dashboard mein ye coupon sirf Starter Course ke liye assign hai, Advanced Course ke liye nahi.

items.description: Customer edited the coupon, selected the Advanced Course in the Products section and saved, following support's guidance, and confirmed on a test that the discount now shows at checkout.
evidence: Ho gaya. Ab test karta hoon... haan, ab checkout pe discount dikh raha hai.

items.description: Support will check with the billing team about the wrong company name in the invoice's GST section and tell the customer.
evidence: Uske liye main billing team se check karke aapko kal tak bata dunga.

items.description: Support explained that the customer can extend the expiry date themselves in the coupon settings, where the date option is available.
evidence: Expiry aap khud coupon settings mein badha sakte ho, wahin date ka option milega.

items.description: Customer will extend the coupon's expiry date in the coupon settings.
evidence: Haan, main aaj raat badha dunga.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
